display_long_description:
**Sign the contract and take on the darkness!**

Sign the contract – explore islands by day. Fortify your lighthouse and survive waves of nightmares by night. Progress your character between contracts in the social lobby. Play solo or with friends via Party Finder – finding your next mission buddy in no time.

[media]
**Explore mysterious locations**

Sail during the day to discover mist-shrouded islands, explore ruins and venture into forgotten undergrounds. Increase your resources and wealth!
[media]
**Prepare for danger**

Use your resources, share responsibilities, craft grenades, lay mines, feed the hungry, heal the wounded… danger is coming!
[media]
**Fight for survival**

To arms! Slash, chop, shoot and blow things up. With over 20 weapons to choose from there’s something for everyone. Plan your tactics or revel in the chaos of battle. Any strategy is good—as long as the light doesn’t go out!
[media]
**Key Features:**

- **Marine exploration:** Travel by boat between lands scattered across the sea.
- **Hand-designed islands:** Randomly selected, carefully crafted side locations – full of puzzles, dungeons and variations ensuring replayability.
- **Progression between missions:** A meta-progression system allowing you to unlock and upgrade your starting weapons and cosmetics for your character.
- **Tactical combat and crafting:** A wide range of enemies and bosses, crafting consumables (mines, grenades, healing items) and fortifications.
- **Rich atmosphere:** A mysterious world set in the 1920s inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft.
